lines.en: I walk on four legs, my young ones behind me.
My duck bill sweeps the ground for shoots.

lines.zh: 沙地上留下成串的脚印。
lines.en: A string of prints is left in the sand.

lines.zh: 鸭嘴龙妈妈走在前，幼崽跟在我脚边。
lines.en: The hadrosaur mother leads; hatchlings trail my feet.
The little one circles my legs.
The grass on this plain is still tender.
I lower my head and sniff the soil.
The herd drifts slowly toward the river.
A flick of my tail shoos the flies.

lines.zh: 白垩纪的日头，还是这样。
lines.en: The Cretaceous sun still feels the same.

lines.zh: 加拿大的旧家园，我记得路。
lines.en: I remember the way across my old Canadian home.

lines.zh: 我绕开水坑，免得陷进去。
lines.en: I go around the pool so I will not sink.
Keep close, little one at the back.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩得结结实实。
lines.en: Every step lands solid.
I walk along the spine of the dune.

lines.zh: 有食草的地方，就有我们。
lines.en: Where there is green, we go.
I stop and wait for the herd to catch up.
Slowly now; there is no rush.
I stand and chew my leaves.

lines.zh: 母性的本能，让我守着它们。
lines.en: A mother's instinct keeps me close to them.
The wind turns the grass into one long whisper.

lines.zh: 我抬头，看看有没有影子。
lines.en: I lift my head to check for shadows.
The sun is warm on my back.
The little one beside me dozes.
I start nothing, but I fear nothing.
There is grazing here for a long time.
I root my snout into the soil.
Wings, somewhere far off.
I swing my tail slowly.
The rim of my bill has worn smooth.
I keep my place among the young.
A low sound rises in my throat.
A while longer; the sun is still high.
I eat plants; grass is all I want.
You stand still, so I look first.
Do not come close; my young are here.
Your hands are still empty, yes?
You are taller than I expected.
I only want to graze in peace.
Your mouth is moving.
I step in front of the little ones.

lines.zh: 你没有要动手的意思吧。
lines.en: You are not about to strike, are you?
I tilt my head at your tool.
You have looked enough. Step back.

lines.zh: 我一叫，小崽就往我身后钻。
lines.en: I cry out and the young duck behind me.
It hurts, but I do not yield.
I only wanted to graze in peace.
I shift my bulk aside a step.
I whimper low.
Thick hide; the wound is not deep.
The little ones will be frightened.

lines.zh: 护着的巢被踩了，我低吼出声。
lines.en: My nest was trampled; I let out a low bellow.
I stare at you without blinking.
Blood shows clearly on the sand.
Leaves, and the tender ones best.
Are you picking from that bush?
These shoots are my favourite.
Is that grass in your hand? Come here.
The smell of green fills my nose.
I want both food and calm.
Do not approach; just toss it.
I can tell which one is sweet.
For this mouthful, I will remember you kindly.
The young ones get this bite first.
I pace over, one step at a time.
There is dew on these blades.
If there is extra, I will carry some off.
So good. Another handful.
I give a low call, which is thanks.
Will you not try a little?

lines.zh: 我这身子骨，撞一下不轻。
lines.en: This body of mine is heavy to run into.
Your shove moved me off my spot.
I pull my feet back in a hurry.
That was my leg; are you hurt?
Between us we have scattered the soil.
I turn broadside to give a path.
Do not startle the little ones.
Slow down; no need to shove.
I call softly and wait for an answer.

lines.zh: 脖子上的色彩，亮起来了。
lines.en: The colour on my neck has brightened.
Let us walk a while side by side.
The nest takes dry twigs and mud.
This meadow is good for raising young.
I will guard you and the little ones.
A light touch of our brows.
Easy; let us learn each other's scent.
One herd, one path.

lines.zh: 白垩纪的春天就这么短。
lines.en: The Cretaceous spring is this short.
This tuft on the ground is mine.
I bite it off and chew slowly.
Grit in my teeth; I spit it out.
Whatever falls by my feet, I take.
The little one will snatch it, so I yield.
Not a bit of this is sweet.
I nudge it with my snout.
I will keep a little back for them.
It smells like bark.
Who is moving over there?
I step forward, guarding the young.
You have walked onto my grazing ground.
I lower my voice into a warning.
I thought you were only passing.
I turn to stand between you and them.
This meadow is ours first.
Do not make me use force.
I lower my head into a stance.
The young have hidden behind me.
I do not chase, but I will hold.
I do not know what you are holding.
I have scraped the soil up under my feet.
My breathing is heavy but steady.
Grass I can find again. My young I cannot.
You had better change direction.

lines.zh: 我一边吃草，一边留意你的脚步。
lines.en: I keep an eye on your footsteps while I graze.
My forelegs push off and I slam into you.
That one was a warning.
My weight is my weapon.
You end up sitting in the dirt.
My tail sweeps round to guard my flank.
Back off; the young are coming through.
Dust covers your face.
I told you not to come close.

lines.zh: 我带着小崽走进这片平原。
lines.en: I walk into this plain with my young.

lines.zh: 沙地上响起沉重的脚步。
lines.en: Heavy steps sound on the sand.
One large, one small, appearing slowly.
We have found new grazing.

lines.zh: 鸭嘴兽脚类，从白垩纪来。
lines.en: A hadrosaur, come from the Cretaceous.
The sun lies across a row of backs.
The little one peers out first; then I follow.
The grass here smells good.

lines.zh: 我护着它们，也护着这片地。
lines.en: I guard them, and this ground too.
My steps startle a few birds up.
Gentle, but not soft.
There are eggs in the nest. Take it slow.
The grass is burning; I have to go.
I fell from a height, and my legs are numb.

lines.zh: 水没到脖子，我使不上劲。
lines.en: The water is at my neck, and I cannot push.
The blast has my ears ringing.
Something has sunk into my leg.
I cannot shake this strange force off.
The grass is gone and my belly is empty.
Thunder struck my back and scorched it.
The ground is gone, and I fall.
